_meta.description: Golden test set — human-adjudicated expected risk tiers for canonical countries. Any scoring change must not regress these without explicit re-adjudication.
_meta.format_note: JSON chosen for stdlib loading consistency with V1.9.1.json. Expected tier is the name of a tier constant the scorer returns.
_meta.tolerance_policy: Where a country's expected tier is ambiguous (e.g., UK Brexit legacy), the field is an array of acceptable labels and the test passes if the actual tier is in the set.

syria.rationale: Active civil war; a risk tier that doesn't flag Syria HIGH is broken.

venezuela.rationale: Economic collapse + political repression; primary case validating Layer-3 composite rule.

iran.rationale: Repression + external risk; Layer-3 composite expected.

nigeria.rationale: Moderate instability; Boko Haram contained regionally.

united_kingdom.rationale: Brexit legacy debatable; either classification defensible.

denmark.rationale: Stable democracy; primary face-validity fix case from #376 — must NOT be HIGH.

cape_verde.rationale: Stable middle-income democracy; #376 origin case — must NOT be HIGH under V1.9.1.
